hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: MANAGED_INPUTS
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: participants-migration --managed-inputs: study list CSV with "Study Abbreviated Name", "Study Identifier", "Data is ready to process"

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: DATA_FOLDER
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: participants-migration --data-folder: folder holding {studyid}_sstr.tsv, {ABV}_PatientMapping.v2.csv, and the shared GLOBAL_allConcepts_merged.csv

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BATCH_SIZE
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Rows per batch insert, passed to every migration job

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: MAPPING_UPLOAD_BASE
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: S3 prefix the orchestrator uploads each {studyid}_hpds_id_mapping.csv to before triggering split-allconcepts. Must be readable by CONTAINER_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN (the split container does ALL S3 I/O as that role). A per-build tag is appended.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: SPLIT_OUTPUT
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Output location for split allConcepts files. Must be an s3:// URI: a local path resolves INSIDE the runner container (/app), which is destroyed with the instance, silently discarding every per-consent CSV.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: ALL_CONCEPTS_JOB
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Jenkins job that runs the generate-global-all-concepts runner

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: ALL_CONCEPTS_OUTPUT
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Output location for global_AllConcepts.csv. Must be an s3:// URI reachable by CONTAINER_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: VCF_INDEXES_JOB
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Jenkins job that runs the create-vcf-indexes runner

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: VCF_INDEXES_OUTPUT
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Output location for vcfIndex.tsv and SampleIds.csv. Must be an s3:// URI reachable by CONTAINER_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: CONTAINER_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Cross-account IAM role ARN for containers to assume when reading S3 inputs from the 73 bucket. Passed to every downstream runner.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: CONTINUE_ON_STUDY_FAILURE
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Keep splitting remaining studies when one fails. Each study is independent.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: RUN_INTEGRATION_TESTS
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Run the Testcontainers *IT suites (needs a Docker daemon on the agent). These are the only checks that assert real DB state, so leaving them on is strongly preferred before a migration.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: PREFLIGHT_ONLY
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Validate every migration input layout and stop, without provisioning anything

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: ENV
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Target environment. Selects etl-runners/environments/<ENV>.tfvars for network, RDS, and account settings.
